description: Shared correctness fixtures for the five lifecycle variants (allocatePerItem, batchArena, threadLocalReuse, globalPool, boundedPool) over three datasets. Lifecycle strategy changes B/op, allocations/op, reset/close cost and contention, never the checksum.

semantics.xorshift64: x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >>> 7 (unsigned/logical); x ^= x << 17 (64-bit wrapping, unsigned interpretation throughout)

messageBatches.fields: id = i (linear); value = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000; flag = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 16 — two xorshift64 advances per message, in order: value, flag
messageBatches.checksum: wrapping sum of (id + value + flag) over all messages

temporaryParseTrees.fields: value[doc][node] = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000, one advance per node, nodes generated in order within a doc, docs in order
temporaryParseTrees.checksum: wrapping sum of value over every node in every document

scratchBuffers.fields: word[op][w] = xorshift64 stream unsigned-mod 1,000,000, one advance per word, words generated in order within an op, ops in order
scratchBuffers.checksum: wrapping sum of word over every word in every buffer op (values round-trip through the scratch buffer as raw bytes before being summed)
